mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide may cause hypokalemia and metabolic alkalosis, which can increase sympathomimetic effects and cardiac arrhythmia risk; lisdexamfetamine increases blood pressure and heart rate, compounding cardiovascular stress.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and serum electrolytes (particularly potassium) regularly; consider potassium supplementation if needed and evaluate necessity of concurrent use.
